bc_sentry.blurb: Sentry is a single block of gneiss on the Fantasyland bench above Arrow Lake in the West Kootenays, and it is the first boulder you meet in the Middle Earth group. It has five problems, one at each grade from V2 up to V6, so a mixed party can all find something to try. Stack a few pads, since the whole group is bouldered, and plan on moving on to the neighbouring blocks afterwards: the Comic boulders and Moria are a short walk further along. The setting is a bench with open views over the lake, close to thicker forest.

bc_moria.blurb: Moria is a boulder in the Middle Earth group of Fantasyland, on a bench above Arrow Lake in the West Kootenays. It holds five problems on gneiss, running from an easy V0 through the middle grades up to a V6 and a V8, so the harder end is well above the others. A cave on the boulder is the main feature, and the holds include some sloping ones. It is reached by following a short trail from the neighbouring Sentry boulder, and it makes a natural stop on a day at Fantasyland. Bring several pads.

bc_watchmen.blurb: Watchmen is a compact gneiss boulder in the Comic group of Fantasyland, above Arrow Lake in the West Kootenays. It carries five problems of mostly short height: an easy V0, then V2 and V3, with a V5 and a V6 project-level line at the top end. It sits just beside the larger Gotham boulder and is passed on your right when walking in from Sentry, so it combines easily with the rest of Comic in one session. Pads and a spotter are worthwhile on a bench like this.

bc_knuckle_head.blurb: Knuckle Head is a small granodiorite crag in the creek canyon of Cypress Falls Park in West Vancouver. It has five single-pitch lines of roughly 15 to 20 metres: two sport climbs, two trad lines and one top rope. Grades run from the high 5.8 range through 5.9 and 5.10 to a pair of 5.11s, so it suits climbers comfortable on moderate trad who also want a couple of harder bolted lines. Bring a small rack of cams for the trad routes. The canyon setting stays cool on hot days, but the rock can take a week or more to dry after heavy rain.

bc_cave.blurb: Cave is a small group of gneiss boulders in the Lounge section of Keenlyside, on Arrow Lake in the West Kootenays. It has five problems and none are easy: one V4, three V5s and a V6, so it suits climbers already working in the harder range. The centrepiece is a very large boulder above the main Lounge blocks, with a few more problems tucked into a little canyon beside it. You can get in by squeezing through the cave itself or by crossing over from the other Lounge boulders.

bc_lounge_left.blurb: Lounge - Left is one tall gneiss boulder on the left side of the Lounge, part of the Keenlyside bouldering at Arrow Lake in the West Kootenays. It has five problems: a pair at V2, one V3 and a pair at V4, a friendly spread for climbers working through the middle grades. Landings are soft and mossy rather than flat rock. To find it, climb to the top of the ladder that leads into the Lounge and look to the left. It sits close to the road and combines easily with the other Lounge blocks.

bc_the_cut.blurb: The Cut is a deep, narrow slot at sea level in Whytecliff Park, near Horseshoe Bay in West Vancouver, separating the West and South Headlands. It is a top-rope spot: four short routes in the 5.5 to 5.7 range, set up from bolted anchors at the top of the wall, plus one boulder problem. The walls are granodiorite, and one side is slabby and partly vegetated. A trail from the car park leads down to a small, driftwood-covered beach at the back of the slot, so it works well for beginners or a short outing.

bc_power_line_2.blurb: Power-Line is one large gneiss boulder in the Power-Line zone of Keenlyside, at Arrow Lake in the West Kootenays. It is hard to miss on your left as you come through the ditch and head up the trail. It holds five problems spread from V3 through V4, V5 and V6 to a V9, so the top end is a serious step beyond the rest. It is the tallest feature in a small zone further down the road from the other Keenlyside sectors, and the trails there link up without returning to the road.
